programme: Bachelor of Computing in Computer Science

categories.label: University Requirements (GE/UE)
categories.notes: General Education Pillars (GEH, GEC, GER, GEQ, GET, GEA) - any matching modules count toward this total.

categories.label: Industry Experience Requirement
categories.notes: Internship (CP3200/3202) or Independent Work Study (CP3107/3110) - only one required.

categories.label: Primary Focus: Artificial Intelligence
categories.notes: Pick at least 5 modules satisfying the AI Primary Focus Area requirements (2 Foundation + 3 Breadth & Depth, per latest curriculum).

categories.label: Unrestricted Electives (UE)
categories.notes: Any modules not otherwise counted, used to top up to the 160 MC total.
